text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a hard-fought battle, Meisho Doto 
lost to T.M. Opera O. However, from that 
moment on—the two became rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O presses, demanding, "Why 
couldn't you run like this until now?" and 
they laugh together, agreeing to hold 
nothing back from now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The change in their relationship showed in 
their lap times as well. Air Shakur became 
certain that by competing together, the 
two had broken past their limiters and 
shattered the ceiling—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, the battle against the older 
generation became unpredictable. Standing 
on equal footing, the two head toward the 
decisive battle at the Arima Kinen.
